definitions.gloss: to throw in; to toss into
definitions.explanation: To throw something carelessly or forcefully into a container or space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I tossed the laundry into the washing machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I throw the garbage into the bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I threw vegetables into the pot one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トランク→トランク：24218_toranku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んで⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：02085_shuppatsu⟧。
examples.english: I tossed the luggage into the car trunk and set off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}いでいた→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カバン→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んで⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I was in a hurry, so I threw my textbook into my bag and left the house.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{放|ほう}る→放る：03939_houru⟧ (to throw) + the compound-forming suffix {込|こ}む, which adds the sense "in, inward". This {込|こ}む is a different word from the independent verb ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to be crowded) and has no entry of its own.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
・〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む - throw something into somewhere; the destination takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ rather than ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧, because the point of arrival matters, not the direction

ASPECT:
{放|ほう}り{込|こ}んでいる normally reads as a repeated or in-progress action, not as a resulting state. To describe the thing as already sitting in the container, use the passive {放|ほう}り{込|こ}まれている.

USAGE:
Implies carelessness, haste, or force:
・⟦カバン→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to toss into a bag)
・⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to throw into the car)
・⟦{牢屋|ろうや}→牢屋：15832_rouya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{込|こ}む (to throw in jail)
The last is figurative: with a person as the object, the verb says the person was put somewhere unpleasant with no regard for their wishes.

NUANCE:
More casual and forceful than ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧, which is neutral about manner. Compare ⟦{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す→放り出す：16163_houridasu⟧, the same base verb with the opposite direction (to throw out, to abandon).
